# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.34

Bilingual UI and configurable branding candidate dated 2026-07-27.

## English and Spanish program UI

- English remains the default and users can select Spanish from login or the
  authenticated sidebar.
- The selected language is stored only in that browser.
- More than 700 fixed UI phrases plus formatted runtime messages cover the
  primary Dashboard, Patients, RX Records, Reports, Import, Audit, live-phone,
  active-session, System Settings, and Call Center surfaces.
- Patient names, notes, clinics, pharmacies, medications, documents, transport
  providers, and other stored business data remain exactly as entered.
- Backoffice remains English-only and does not load the translation runtime.

## Configurable branding

- Administrators can change the application name, login/sidebar title, login
  subtitle, bundled Font Awesome icon, optional same-site icon path, and
  optional same-site login background under **System Settings > General**.
- The visual icon gallery includes medication, passenger transportation,
  accessible/medical transportation, people-riding-in-a-minivan, and
  minivan-boarding choices.
- Custom image paths are restricted to safe same-site paths and invalid values
  fall back to bundled assets.

## Safety boundaries

- No proxy, origin, port, route, authentication, CSRF, session, PBX, relay,
  call-placement, or RX Softphone behavior changes.
- No database migration or patient/business data rewrite. Branding uses new
  keys in the existing audited System Settings key/value table.
- Add/Edit permission controls use stable non-translated mode markers, including
  browser coverage for add-only and edit-only roles in Spanish.
- RX Softphone remains version `0.6.0`; no workstation update is required.

## Validation

- Localization/branding regression and generated glossary validation.
- Public JavaScript syntax and UTF-8 validation.
- Reports EJS rendering regression.
- Complete isolated staging browser suite, including bilingual Call Center,
  business-data preservation, role boundaries, reports/downloads, Patients,
  RX workflows, and Spanish Add/Edit permissions.

Promote through `staging`, `develop`, and `main`. Publish and install only the
official checksummed release through Project Control; preserve production
`.env` unchanged.
